The pole appears to be mounted on or near a stone structure. Dancers in folk costumes are holding the ribbons and appear to be performing a weaving dance. Trees form the background.

The foliage in the background has a repetitive, patterned look rather than distinct leaves, and some tree trunks blend slightly into the background, indicating weak depth separation.
